params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: The brief replaces the wording on the home page, the post cards, the Reports page, the contact page, the newsletter block and the footer. Words only; layout, sections and illustrations stay.

What is asked, block by block (current text matched on main):

- Home hero: the paragraph under "Read, understand, activate" gets a new two-sentence text (young Europe before it shows up in your data; twenty years of decoding, read in real time). The hero heading stays.
- Home stats strip: the platform line names TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest, Rednote, Douyin and Bilibili, plus reports and cultural publications.
- Post cards (home and Posts): the call on every card reads "Read the post", also when the post is locked (it said "Read the teaser").
- How we read: step 01 Signal speaks of signals from Western and Asian platforms plus curated reports; step 03 says "researchers" instead of "editors".
- Where AI stops: new intro (hybrid by design, semioticians with twenty years of youth culture) and new bodies for the three columns; the third column's title becomes "Stay relevant". The labels Depth, Context and Speed stay.
- Built for professionals: three new labels and lines (brands and strategy teams; agencies and media; employers and institutions).
- Reports page: the line under "A new report every month." gains a first sentence on what each report does.
- Contact: the right-hand block becomes "Custom research and strategy sessions" with a new text; the consent text uses the newsletter's new name.
- Newsletter: the name is "Gentells This Week" everywhere (site, forms, confirmation mail and page, the newsletter mail itself), the block text and button follow.
- Footer: the line by the Trendwolves mark adds who developed the product (a named person, in the brief).

Rules from the brief: British English; Gen Z, Gen Alpha and ZAlpha spelled so; a placeholder booking link is left out until it is supplied; a text that does not fit its element without a layout change is flagged, not forced.

Also asked: the Lifestage filter on Posts shows Students and Young Families, only if posts carry those tags. The filter already lists exactly the lifestages that have posts (`Taxonomy::lifestagesWithContent`), so the two appear by themselves once a post is tagged with them; no change needed.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Copy update: home, posts, reports, contact, newsletter and footer
